headline: Ten AI agents move aviation from reactive coordination to predictive orchestration.
narration: In this three minute executive demo, the original video audio is removed. AIonOS overlays ten aviation AI agents from commercial and business aviation into one transparent command layer. The background accelerates to end exactly with the narration.
equation: Outcome = Σ(agent decisions) × context confidence − operational drag

headline: Predictive Aircraft Maintenance detects degradation 48–72 hours before disruption.
narration: Agent one is predictive aircraft maintenance. It listens to vibration, temperature, pressure and oil signals, detects degradation patterns, scores component risk, and auto generates work orders before an aircraft on ground event hits the network.
equation: RUL = f(vibration, temperature, pressure, oil, cycles)

headline: Revenue Leakage Control & Yield AI recovers money hidden inside airline transaction flows.
narration: Agent two is revenue leakage control and yield AI. It scans PSS and DCS data for unbilled ancillaries, fare class mismatches, interline settlement gaps and no show revenue loss, then pushes prioritized recovery queues to revenue teams.
equation: Leakage = booked revenue − billed revenue − settled revenue

headline: AI-Native Passenger CX & Contact Centre turns disruption into proactive service recovery.
narration: Agent three is passenger CX and contact centre intelligence. Voice, chat, social sentiment, reservation status, loyalty context and OCC events converge so passengers are proactively informed, rebooked and served before call volume spikes.
equation: CX Priority = sentiment × disruption severity × loyalty context

headline: Fuel Optimisation & Carbon Intelligence improves each sector’s route, uplift and emissions profile.
narration: Agent four is fuel optimisation and carbon intelligence. It compares uplift, climb, cruise, descent, route, aircraft weight and weather, then recommends fuel optimal options while calculating carbon output per tail and route for compliance reporting.
equation: Fuel Burn = f(weight, route, wind, altitude, thrust)

headline: Crew Scheduling & Operations AI protects legality, productivity and recovery speed during irregular operations.
narration: Agent five is crew scheduling and operations AI. It optimises pairing and rostering against duty, rest and demand constraints. During disruption, it ranks recovery options by cost, legality, availability and network impact.
equation: Best Crew Plan = argmin(cost + delay + illegality penalty)

headline: AI On-Demand Scheduling & Trip Intelligence compresses charter quote creation from hours to seconds.
narration: Agent six is on demand scheduling and trip intelligence. Aircraft availability, crew qualification, airport slots, route constraints and NOTAMs are matched instantly to build optimised quotes and booking workflows for private aviation operators.
equation: Trip Score = aircraft fit + crew fit + slot feasibility − constraint risk

headline: Condition-Based Maintenance shifts private fleets from calendar servicing to real health-based action.
narration: Agent seven is condition based maintenance. It monitors avionics and airframe sensor data, detects deviation thresholds and recommends maintenance only when health evidence justifies action, improving aircraft availability and reducing unscheduled work.
equation: Maintenance Trigger = health deviation > threshold confidence

headline: VIP Passenger Personalisation AI turns every trip into a memory-aware concierge experience.
narration: Agent eight is VIP passenger personalisation. Catering, cabin configuration, ground transport, preferred FBOs and dietary requirements are converted into dynamic preference profiles that update after every journey and trigger service actions automatically.
equation: Preference Match = profile memory × trip context × service availability

headline: Ground Ops Turnaround Intelligence resequences fuelling, catering, cleaning and handling in real time.
narration: Agent nine is ground operations turnaround intelligence. It tracks fuelling, catering, cleaning and handling agents against plan, identifies slippage and resequences ramp tasks to protect departure time and reduce incident risk.
equation: Turnaround Risk = Σ(task delay × critical path weight)

headline: AI Flight Planning & Route Optimisation closes the loop with fuel-optimal and carbon-aware routing.
narration: Agent ten is AI flight planning and route optimisation. Live weather, NOTAMs, wind patterns and airspace restrictions are fused into sector level recommendations, enabling reroute decisions, lower fuel burn, better flight time and measurable carbon reduction.
equation: Optimal Route = argmin(fuel + time + weather risk + airspace constraints)
